parameters.declaration:
NUM_MID_REGS = PIPE_CONFIG == fpnew_pkg::INSIDE
                          ? NUM_PIPE_REGS
                          : (PIPE_CONFIG == fpnew_pkg::DISTRIBUTED
                             ? ((NUM_PIPE_REGS + 2) / 3) // First to get distributed regs
                             : 0)

parameters.name: NUM_OUT_REGS
parameters.declaration:
NUM_OUT_REGS = PIPE_CONFIG == fpnew_pkg::AFTER
                            ? NUM_PIPE_REGS
                            : (PIPE_CONFIG == fpnew_pkg::DISTRIBUTED
                               ? (NUM_PIPE_REGS / 3) // Last to get distributed regs
                               : 0)

method.svMode: one isolated parser process and syntax tree per source file; included-header and primary-file diagnostics distinguished
method.graph: Module/class source references extracted from actual syntax nodes; target names resolved only when unique in the indexed snapshot.
method.referenceCorpusScope: MPACT repositories: only files explicitly cited by content/software.json; copied as text, not syntax-parsed.
method.syntaxDiagnosticsInterpretation: Standalone syntax diagnostics and parser exceptions are indexing observations; no full-chip build was attempted, so they do not establish that the chip cannot be built. The initial indexer exception was repaired; its recovery is recorded separately.

limitations: This is a syntax reference graph, not a whole-chip elaborated netlist, timing graph or signal-level dataflow.
SV analysis uses explicit teaching-index feature flags, not a claim that every build configuration enables Zvt or RVV.
Generate conditions, Chisel configuration-dependent construction, compiler macros and external packages require the original build for authoritative elaboration.

The index excludes third_party, .agents, package caches, Git metadata, symlinks and binaries; text over 2 MB and the generated model/test MLIR corpus remain metadata-only with fixed-commit links. No LLVM source tree is exported.
Some standalone UVM/header-dependent files have recoverable syntax diagnostics; their declarations are not counted as a successful hardware compile.
Only RstSync plus ClockGate has separate actual Verilator elaboration evidence; no full-core RTL simulation or synthesis was run.
